deliverable: A source-grounded summary of the announced course plan from the two captured openings (parts 1 and 2) of one Bilibili course-introduction video, with per-segment locators, explicit ASR limits, and no claims about slides or later content.

turns.text: Using only these two captured openings, summarize the announced course plan: the course title, the audience it is meant to attract, the practical work it includes, and the areas announced for the three weeks. Attribute each point to part 1 or part 2 and give the ASR segment locator.

Part 1 only: what does the speaker say the course hopes to achieve for students from other disciplines, what does he say about how the course is taught, and what project work does he describe? Flag any sentence the ASR renders too noisily to use.

Part 2 only: lay out the three-week topic sequence and the cross-disciplinary fields it names. State explicitly which parts of the plan are missing from the captured transcript and do not fill the gaps in from outside knowledge.

acceptable_partial_outcomes: The transcripts are local ASR of the opening minutes only; answers must not claim slide, frame, caption or other on-screen content, nor any part of the video beyond the captured opening.

Part 2 is missing the second announced aspect and the middle of the first aspect; the answer must say the announced plan cannot be reconstructed in full.
